prerequisiteOrder: bound Dojo and Sonar credential presence
mandatory complete current Trivy audit native reports
dedupe: same report reimport must preserve exact sorted Finding IDs
pagination: tests limit100/findings limit200, follow same-origin next, max100 pages; not first-page assumption
errorSemantics: credentials/report/native/input/query/dedupe/API/write failures FAIL in existing Gate; finding severity count itself does not redefine scanner Gate
retrySemantics: GET/PATCH bounded transport or 502/503/504 retries; import POST not retried
adapter: infra/security/policy/dojo-parent.mjs; uses unchanged original client against frozen observations
runtimeObservationGap: observe.mjs has no passive Dojo API observer; projection contract requires actual request/response observations and files, not native report status success
blockingPrerequisite: .devsecops/trivy-audit.json absent in current validation context; Trivy ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED; other current native reports also missing

safeAlternativeAssessment.existingIsolatedProductIdentity: possible only after reports ready; do not use existing identity authorized for production Products1/2
safeAlternativeAssessment.temporaryIsolatedDojo: does not create absent current Trivy/native inputs; no temporary environment deployed
safeAlternativeAssessment.verifyOnlyOrSubsetImport: cannot satisfy full frozen parent without changing Gate or decoupling, both outside scope
